decisions.reason: As a standard rye bread tightly aligned with existing routines, channels, and demand, it likely meets aspiration levels absent any visible negative signal and is therefore kept.
The premium raisin stollen remains a flagship product and its prior gold-medal recognition is a strong above-aspiration cue, making withdrawal very unlikely.
This seeded rye mixed bread fits the established assortment with low additional strain, so boundedly rational management would continue it unless clear underperformance emerges.
The marzipan Christmas stollen sits close to the firm’s seasonal strengths and, with no evidence of a shortfall, is likely retained as part of the holiday portfolio.
Ancient grain bread is still the most experimental offer, but after remaining on the market another year and using existing baking capabilities it is more likely to be continued than dropped.
